blocks.en: This page deals primarily with the mechanics of faction warfare. For tips on how best to take advantage of these mechanics, see Faction warfare strategy and tactics.
blocks.zh: 本页主要介绍势力战争的机制。关于如何更好地利用这些机制，请参见势力战争策略与战术。

blocks.en: Faction warfare (FW) is a game mechanic whereby you can sign up to fight for one of the four empire factions (against its enemy faction) for control over certain areas of low-sec space. It was first introduced in the Empyrean Age expansion (2008) to offer players a stepping-stone into player-vs-player (PvP) gameplay. In 2022, the Uprising expansion made sweeping changes across many Faction Warfare mechanics, and the Havoc expansion (2023) added the ability to enlist with the Guristas and Angels pirate militias to fight against the empires and participate in Insurgencies.
blocks.zh: 势力战争（Faction Warfare，FW）是一种游戏机制：你可以报名为四大帝国势力之一作战（对抗它的敌对势力），争夺部分低安空间的控制权。它最早在 2008 年的帝国时代（Empyrean Age）资料片中推出，目的是为玩家提供一块进入玩家对战（PvP）玩法的跳板。2022 年，起义（Uprising）资料片对势力战争的许多机制进行了全面改动；2023 年的浩劫（Havoc）资料片则加入了加入古斯塔斯和天使海盗民兵的选项，可以与各帝国作战并参与叛乱（Insurgency）。

blocks.en: Faction warfare is primarily centered around two war zones (areas of low-sec contested by two empires): the Amarr-Minmatar war zone and the Caldari-Gallente war zone, which each are located on the border of the two respective empires. In these war zones, players who participate in Factional Warfare attempt to conquer star systems for their empire, and are rewarded with loyalty points and increased faction standings for their efforts. Additionally, as players who participate in Factional Warfare are effectively at war with one of the four empire factions in the game, they can therefore attack (and be attacked by) players fighting for the enemy faction anywhere in New Eden, as well as fight the enemy NPC faction navies (who patrol the high-sec star systems belonging to their faction). In addition to fighting their rival empire militia, players who participate in Factional Warfare are also at war with one of the two pirate militias as part of the Pirate Insurgency. Members of the Amarr and Minmatar militias are at war with the Angel Cartel, while members of the Caldari and Gallente militias are fighting the Guristas Pirates. In insurgency warzones, empire militia members can capture plexes to increase Suppression, and pirate militia members can capture plexes to increase Corruption.
blocks.zh: 势力战争主要围绕两个战区（由两个帝国争夺的低安区域）展开：艾玛-米玛塔尔战区和加达里-盖伦特战区，分别位于两对帝国的交界处。在这些战区中，参与势力战争的玩家努力为自己的帝国夺取星系，并因此获得忠诚点和势力声望提升作为奖励。此外，由于参与势力战争的玩家实际上与游戏中四大帝国势力之一处于战争状态，他们可以在新伊甸的任何地方攻击为敌对势力作战的玩家（也会被对方攻击），还可以与敌方 NPC 势力海军作战（这些海军在其势力所属的高安星系巡逻）。除了与敌对帝国民兵作战外，作为海盗叛乱的一部分，参与势力战争的玩家还与两个海盗民兵之一处于战争状态。艾玛和米玛塔尔民兵的成员与天使企业联合体交战，而加达里和盖伦特民兵的成员则与古斯塔斯海盗作战。在叛乱战区中，帝国民兵成员可以占领据点来提升镇压度（Suppression），海盗民兵成员则可以占领据点来提升腐化度（Corruption）。

blocks.en: Joining Factional Warfare
blocks.zh: 加入势力战争

blocks.en: There are two ways to join Factional Warfare (the game calls this "enlisting"): join as a solo player, or join as part of a player corporation or alliance. You do not need to be a part of Faction warfare to fight those who are enlisted.
blocks.zh: 加入势力战争（游戏中称为“参军”）有两种方式：以个人身份加入，或者作为玩家军团或联盟的一员加入。即使你没有参加势力战争，也可以和已参军的玩家作战。

blocks.en: EVE University is able to participate in Factional Warfare!!
blocks.zh: EVE University 可以参与势力战争！！

blocks.en: Joining as a solo player
blocks.zh: 以个人身份加入

blocks.en: Join Factional Warfare through the Militia Office window in a station belonging to the empire you wish to fight for (in this example, the Caldari).
blocks.zh: 在你想为之作战的帝国（本例中为加达里）所属的空间站中，通过民兵办公室（Militia Office）窗口加入势力战争。

blocks.en: Any player can join Factional Warfare provided that their base standings towards the empire faction (e.g. the Gallente Federation or the Caldari State) they wish to fight for are 0.0 or greater. Note that only raw, unmodified standings (i.e. without taking the effects of skills like Social into account) count; you can check your standings on your character page.
blocks.zh: 任何玩家只要对想要效力的帝国势力（例如盖伦特联邦或加达里合众国）的基础声望不低于 0.0，就可以加入势力战争。注意，只计算原始的、未经修正的声望（即不考虑社会学等技能的效果）；你可以在角色页面查看自己的声望。

blocks.en: You can enlist at any station belonging to the empire or pirate faction you wish to fight for by opening the "Militia Office" window (from the NeoCom or the Station Services window) for empire militias, and by opening the Insurgencies window (from the Activities section of the Neocom) for pirate militias. Note that even though the Khanid Kingdom and the Ammatar Mandate are affiliated with the Amarr Empire, they do not count as being a part of it, and therefore you cannot join Factional Warfare from their stations.
blocks.zh: 对于帝国民兵，你可以在想要效力的帝国势力所属的任何空间站，打开“民兵办公室”窗口（通过 NeoCom 或空间站服务窗口）参军；对于海盗民兵，则通过打开叛乱窗口（在 NeoCom 的活动栏目中）参军。注意，尽管卡尼迪王国和艾玛达共和国隶属于艾玛帝国，但它们并不算艾玛帝国的一部分，因此你不能在它们的空间站加入势力战争。

blocks.en: A player enlisting while a member of an NPC corporation will leave that corporation, and automatically join one of the six faction militia corporations (NPC-run corporations which are populated exclusively by other players enlisted in Factional Warfare for a given empire):
blocks.zh: 身在 NPC 军团的玩家参军后会离开该军团，并自动加入六个势力民兵军团之一（由 NPC 运营、成员全部是为某个帝国参加势力战争的玩家的军团）：

zh: 艾玛：帝国十字军第二十四军团
盖伦特：联邦防务联合会
米玛塔尔：部族解放力量
天使企业联合体：摩拉基穆狂热者
古斯塔斯海盗：古力突击队

blocks.en: Joining as a solo player happens immediately. These militia corporations have NPC agents working for them, which offer missions to pilots enlisted with their respective faction.
blocks.zh: 以个人身份加入会立即生效。这些民兵军团有为其工作的 NPC 代理人，向参加各自势力的驾驶员提供任务。

blocks.en: Direct Enlistment
blocks.zh: 直接参军

blocks.en: An unaligned corporation may allow individuals to Direct Enlist in Factional Warfare without enlisting the entire corporation. If corporation settings allow for it, members of the same corporation can join opposing factions, becoming legal Militia War Targets to each other. Corporation leadership can limit the factions that members are able to join in order to prevent corpmates from becoming war targets to each other, to focus on aiding a specific faction, or for any other reason. With Direct Enlistment enabled, corporation members may enlist and unenlist in faction warfare at will with any faction that their corporation allows for and that they have sufficient standing to enlist with.
blocks.zh: 一个未结盟的军团可以允许成员个人直接参军（Direct Enlist）加入势力战争，而无需整个军团参军。如果军团设置允许，同一军团的成员可以加入对立的势力，彼此成为合法的民兵战争目标。军团领导层可以限制成员能加入的势力，以防军团成员互相成为战争目标，或是专注于援助某一特定势力，或出于其他任何原因。启用直接参军后，军团成员可以随意加入或退出势力战争，只要该势力是军团所允许的，并且他们的声望足以参军。

blocks.en: Enlisting or retiring individually using Direct Enlistment happens immediately. Once you have Retired from a FW militia you may not enlist in FW again for 24 hours, after which time you may re-enlist at will.
blocks.zh: 通过直接参军方式个人参军或退役会立即生效。从势力战争民兵退役后，24 小时内不能再次参军，之后可以随时重新参军。

blocks.en: Joining as a corporation
blocks.zh: 以军团身份加入

blocks.en: The CEO or Director of a corporation can enlist their entire corporation (i.e. all their members) to Factional Warfare, and the executor of an alliance may do so on behalf of the alliance. When part of an alliance the corporation retains the decision to join Faction Warfare, so an Alliance can not prevent a member corporation from joining. However, due to wars being shared between alliances and their member corps, when a corp joins a militia, the entire alliance is enlisted as well. It is recommended that, if the alliance does not wish to be enlisted, corps who want to participate in Faction Warfare should either leave the alliance or enable Direct Enlistment so their members can freely join a militia. While individual pilots can join and leave the militias at any time, corporations and alliances will have to wait some time before they are joined into the warfare and may fight on behalf of their chosen empire. As with solo players, the corporation must have a standing of 0.0 or greater towards the empire they wish to fight for (corporation standings are an average of its all members' individual standings, see corporation standings for more details). Enlisting a corporation takes effect after the next downtime.
blocks.zh: 军团的 CEO 或总监可以让整个军团（即所有成员）加入势力战争，联盟的执行者也可以代表联盟这样做。在联盟中时，加入势力战争的决定权仍在军团手中，因此联盟无法阻止成员军团加入。不过，由于战争状态在联盟及其成员军团之间共享，当一个军团加入民兵时，整个联盟也会一起参军。如果联盟不希望参军，建议想参与势力战争的军团要么退出联盟，要么启用直接参军，让成员可以自由加入民兵。个人驾驶员可以随时加入或退出民兵，而军团和联盟则需要等待一段时间，才能正式加入战争并为所选帝国作战。与个人玩家一样，军团对想要效力的帝国的声望必须不低于 0.0（军团声望是其所有成员个人声望的平均值，详见军团声望）。军团参军会在下一次停机维护后生效。

blocks.en: Players must be in a corporation flagged for Factional Warfare to participate. There is no way for an individual in a FW corp to opt out – if the corporation changes their flag to join the militia, every member of that corporation automatically joins with the corp.
blocks.zh: 玩家必须身在标记为参加势力战争的军团中才能参与。势力战争军团中的个人无法选择退出——如果军团更改标记加入民兵，该军团的每个成员都会自动随军团一起加入。

blocks.en: Note: If the CEO or Director is Direct Enlisted, the UI to enlist the Corporation will be unavailable until after they disenroll.
blocks.zh: 注意：如果 CEO 或总监本人是直接参军的，那么在他们退役之前，军团参军的界面将不可用。

blocks.en: Third-partying
blocks.zh: 第三方介入

blocks.en: It is possible for third parties (those not enrolled in Faction warfare directly) to fight those who are. Sliding into a complex or aggressing a capsuleer enrolled in faction warfare will generally give a Suspect Timer (see that page for exceptions). It will also decrease security status and decrease standing with the targeted faction. Third-parties will not receive Faction warfare rewards like Loyalty Points (LP).
blocks.zh: 第三方（没有直接参加势力战争的人）也可以和参战者作战。进入据点或攻击参加势力战争的克隆飞行员，一般会获得嫌犯计时器（例外情况见该页面）。这还会降低安全等级，并降低与目标所属势力的声望。第三方不会获得忠诚点（LP）等势力战争奖励。

blocks.en: Third-partying on faction warfare is a common way to find PvP content in lowsec space for those not enrolled in Faction warfare themselves, such as EVE University members.
blocks.zh: 对于没有参加势力战争的人，例如 EVE University 的成员来说，以第三方身份介入势力战争是在低安寻找 PvP 内容的常见方式。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Before the Allegiance update (patch notes 2023-03-14.1), the Amarr and the Caldari were allied (as were the Minmatar and the Gallente), which meant that pilots fighting for (for instance) the Gallente were able to help their Minmatar allies fight against the Amarr (with the exception of infrastructure hubs), and attack (and be attacked by) pilots fighting for the Amarr as well as the Caldari. Additionally, that same pilot was attacked by the NPC faction navies of the Amarr and the Caldari when entering their high-sec space.
blocks.zh: 在效忠（Allegiance）更新（更新说明 2023-03-14.1）之前，艾玛和加达里是盟友（米玛塔尔和盖伦特也是），这意味着（例如）为盖伦特作战的驾驶员可以帮助米玛塔尔盟友对抗艾玛（基础设施枢纽除外），并且可以攻击为艾玛和加达里作战的驾驶员（也会被他们攻击）。此外，这名驾驶员进入艾玛和加达里的高安空间时，会遭到这两个势力的 NPC 海军攻击。

blocks.en: War zones
blocks.zh: 战区

blocks.en: Factional Warfare revolves around two conflicts, one between the Amarr and the Minmatar, and the other between the Caldari and the Gallente. The majority of the actions take place in two areas of low-security space, each of which is contested by two empires, known as "war zones".
blocks.zh: 势力战争围绕两场冲突展开，一场在艾玛与米玛塔尔之间，另一场在加达里与盖伦特之间。大部分行动发生在两片低安空间中，每片都由两个帝国争夺，称为“战区”。

blocks.en: The Amarr-Minmatar war zone extends into parts of the Devoid, Bleak Lands, Heimatar and Metropolis regions, while the Caldari-Gallente war zone extends into parts of the Black Rise, Citadel, Essence, Verge Vendor, and Placid regions. The high-security systems on the borders of the war zones are often used as staging areas (as players fighting for the enemy militia cannot enter them without being attacked by friendly NPC faction navy ships), although many player corporations also use systems inside the war zones themselves as home bases. The core Factional Warfare gameplay of capturing systems and running missions takes place exclusively within the war zones. Dotlan has very useful maps of the war zones.
blocks.zh: 艾玛-米玛塔尔战区延伸到破碎、幽暗之域、西玛特尔和美特伯里斯星域的部分地区，而加达里-盖伦特战区则延伸到暗涌之域、赛塔德洱、精华之域、维格温铎和宁静之域星域的部分地区。战区边缘的高安星系常被用作集结地（因为为敌方民兵作战的玩家进入这些星系会遭到友方 NPC 势力海军舰船攻击），不过也有很多玩家军团把战区内部的星系作为基地。势力战争中占领星系和执行任务的核心玩法完全发生在战区之内。Dotlan 上有非常实用的战区地图。

blocks.en: Capturing systems
blocks.zh: 占领星系

blocks.en: An illustration of how to capture (or defend) a star system in Factional Warfare (using a system contested by the Amarr and the Minmatar as an example).
blocks.zh: 势力战争中如何占领（或防守）一个星系的示意图（以艾玛和米玛塔尔争夺的星系为例）。

blocks.en: The core mechanics of Factional Warfare revolve around capturing and holding star systems in the war zones. This occurs in two steps:
blocks.zh: 势力战争的核心机制围绕着占领和守住战区中的星系展开。这分为两步：

en: Attacking and completing complexes ("plexes") in a system to make the system vulnerable to capture.
Once the system is vulnerable, attack and destroy ("capture") the system's infrastructure hub (also known as an "i-Hub") to capture the system.
zh: 攻打并完成星系中的据点（“plex”），使该星系变为可被占领状态。
星系变为可被占领状态后，攻击并摧毁（“占领”）该星系的基础设施枢纽（也称“I-Hub”），从而占领星系。

blocks.en: A system starts off as "stable" (or "uncontested"). The attacking faction (for instance, pilots flying for the Gallente attacking a Caldari-held system) must first attack and complete complexes in the system (this is known as "offensive plexing"); for each completed complex, the system becomes ever more "contested" (commonly quoted from 0% to 100%, sometimes also measured in victory points). Once a system has become 100% contested, it is listed as "vulnerable", and the attacking faction can then attack the system's infrastructure hub. Once the infrastructure hub is destroyed, the system is considered "lost" and will switch to the attacking faction's control after the next server downtime.
blocks.zh: 星系最初处于“稳定”（或“无争夺”）状态。进攻方势力（例如为盖伦特作战、攻打加达里星系的驾驶员）必须先攻打并完成星系中的据点（这称为“进攻刷据点”）；每完成一个据点，星系的“争夺”程度就会进一步提高（通常用 0% 到 100% 表示，有时也用胜利点数衡量）。星系的争夺度达到 100% 后，就会显示为“易攻”，此时进攻方势力可以攻击该星系的基础设施枢纽。基础设施枢纽被摧毁后，该星系即被视为“失守”，并在下一次服务器停机维护后转由进攻方势力控制。

blocks.en: During this time, the defending faction can also complete complexes in the system (this is known as "defensive plexing"); for each completed complex, the system becomes ever less "contested" (or, if it's currently "vulnerable", it will revert to being "contested"), all the way back to "stable".
blocks.zh: 在此期间，防守方势力也可以完成星系中的据点（这称为“防守刷据点”）；每完成一个据点，星系的“争夺”程度就会降低（如果当前处于“易攻”状态，则会退回“争夺中”），一直可以降回“稳定”。

blocks.en: While a system is "vulnerable" or "lost", the attacking faction may still capture complexes, but they will not get any reward nor affect the system's capture. Additionally, once a system is "vulnerable", the defending faction needs only to capture a few complexes to revert the system to "contested" (and therefore render the infrastructure hub invulnerable again); the attacking faction only create a small "buffer" against this by capturing more complexes while the system is "vulnerable". Similarly, once the defending faction has captured enough complexes to revert a system to "stable", the attacking faction only needs to capture one complex to put the system back to "contested".
blocks.zh: 当星系处于“易攻”或“失守”状态时，进攻方势力仍然可以占领据点，但不会获得任何奖励，也不会影响星系的占领进度。此外，星系一旦变为“易攻”，防守方势力只需占领几个据点，就能让星系退回“争夺中”（从而让基础设施枢纽再次变为无敌）；进攻方势力只能在星系“易攻”期间多占领一些据点，来建立一个小小的“缓冲”以对抗这一点。同样，一旦防守方势力占领足够多的据点让星系退回“稳定”，进攻方势力只需占领一个据点就能让星系重新变为“争夺中”。

blocks.en: Obviously, in addition to the mechanics above, pilots can (and should!) attack the other faction's pilots to stop them from completing their objectives!
blocks.zh: 显然，除了上述机制之外，驾驶员还可以（而且应该！）攻击对方势力的驾驶员，阻止他们完成目标！

blocks.en: Complexes
blocks.zh: 据点

blocks.en: The layout of a complex. To enter a complex, you must first activate the complex' acceleration gate, which will warp you into the complex at its beacon. In order to capture the complex, you must stay within 30 km of the capture point.
blocks.zh: 据点的布局。要进入据点，你必须先激活据点的加速门，它会把你传送到据点信标处。要占领据点，你必须待在占领点 30 km 范围内。

blocks.en: Complexes can be found via the probe scanner.
blocks.zh: 据点可以通过探针扫描器找到。

blocks.en: An overview showing typical Factional Warfare objects.
blocks.zh: 显示典型势力战争对象的总览。

blocks.en: Factional Warfare Complexes, commonly known as "Plexes" (not to be confused with PLEX) are small areas of Deadspace in war zone star systems. They are a type of Cosmic Anomaly, which means that they show up on the system scanner (but do not need scan probes to find), although once someone has warped to a complex, they will also show up on the Overview (even when someone initiated a warp to them, but canceled it immediately).
blocks.zh: 势力战争据点（Complex），通常称为“plex”（不要和伊甸币（PLEX）混淆），是战区星系中的小块死亡空间。它们属于宇宙异常，也就是说它们会显示在星系扫描器上（不需要扫描探针就能找到）；而一旦有人跃迁到某个据点，它也会显示在总览上（即使有人只是发起跃迁后立刻取消也是如此）。

blocks.en: Like most other Deadspace Complexes, you cannot warp directly into them, but must first use an acceleration gate, after which you will land at the complex' beacon (Open Complexes (see below) do not have an acceleration gate, but are still a deadspace grid); you cannot light a cynosural field inside or on grid outside a complex. As of the Loyalty to Lowsec Update in March 2020, pilots who are not active Faction Warfare participants will have to go suspect in order to take the gate. The gate may be activated from up to 100km away (but warpins are measured from the beacon and may vary as all warps do, so warping at 100km does not guarantee you will be able to slide immediately).
blocks.zh: 和大多数其他死亡空间复合体一样，你不能直接跃迁进去，必须先使用加速门，之后会降落在据点的信标处（开放据点（见下文）没有加速门，但仍然是死亡空间网格）；你不能在据点内部或据点外的同一网格上开启诱导力场。自 2020 年 3 月的“效忠低安”（Loyalty to Lowsec）更新起，没有积极参加势力战争的驾驶员必须变为嫌犯才能使用加速门。加速门最远可以在 100km 外激活（但跃迁落点是以信标为准计算的，而且和所有跃迁一样会有偏差，所以跃迁到 100km 并不能保证你可以立刻进门）。

blocks.en: At the center of each complex, a few kilometers away from the beacon, is the capture point (sometimes called a "button"). An NPC ship belonging to the faction controlling the star system defends the complex.
blocks.zh: 每个据点的中心，距离信标几公里处，是占领点（有时称为“按钮”）。一艘属于该星系控制方势力的 NPC 舰船负责防守据点。

blocks.en: Capturing complexes
blocks.zh: 占领据点

blocks.en: In order to capture a complex, you must first clear the area (radius: 30 km) around the capture point of enemy ships. If you're the attacking faction, this includes killing the defending NPC; if you're the defending faction, the NPC will obviously not fire on you, and therefore you shouldn't destroy it (even if it appears as "hostile" on your overview)!. Then you must stay inside the capture radius (within 30 km of the capture point) until the complex' timer has counted down to 0 (you can see how much time is left by selecting the capture point), at which point you will have captured the complex!
blocks.zh: 要占领一个据点，你必须先清除占领点周围区域（半径 30 km）内的敌方舰船。如果你是进攻方势力，这包括击杀防守的 NPC；如果你是防守方势力，NPC 显然不会向你开火，因此你不应该摧毁它（即使它在总览上显示为“敌对”）！然后你必须待在占领半径内（距离占领点 30 km 以内），直到据点的计时器倒数到 0（选中占领点可以查看剩余时间），此时你就占领了这个据点！

blocks.en: An Amarr pilot capturing an Amarr complex ("defensive plexing"). The timer on the capture point shows how much time is left before the complex is captured.
blocks.zh: 一名艾玛驾驶员正在占领一个艾玛据点（“防守刷据点”）。占领点上的计时器显示据点被占领前的剩余时间。

blocks.en: Additional ships from your faction will not make the timer count down faster; when you leave the complex or the capture radius, the timer will pause (but will not reset). If an enemy ship enters the complex, the timer will also pause until ships from only one faction are present in the complex capture radius, and then it will resume counting down. Note that the timers for both factions are additive - so if a Caldari pilot has spent three minutes capturing a complex, and is then destroyed by an incoming Gallente pilot, the Gallente pilot would have to spend an extra three minutes in the complex in order to capture it (in order to "undo the capturing" previously done by the Caldari pilot, so to speak).
blocks.zh: 本方势力的舰船再多，也不会让计时器倒数得更快；当你离开据点或占领半径时，计时器会暂停（但不会重置）。如果有敌方舰船进入据点，计时器也会暂停，直到占领半径内只剩一方势力的舰船时才会继续倒数。注意，双方势力的计时是累加的——所以如果一名加达里驾驶员已经花了三分钟占领某个据点，然后被赶来的盖伦特驾驶员击毁，那么这名盖伦特驾驶员需要在据点里额外多花三分钟才能占领它（可以说是为了“撤销”之前加达里驾驶员的占领进度）。

blocks.en: No ship can cloak within the capture radius of a complex. Neutral pilots (i.e. pilots who are not enlisted in a militia) can enter a complex, but cannot capture it (their presence doesn't affect the complex' timer).
blocks.zh: 在据点的占领半径内，任何舰船都无法隐形。中立驾驶员（即没有加入民兵的驾驶员）可以进入据点，但无法占领它（他们的存在不会影响据点的计时器）。

blocks.en: Once a complex has been captured, it disappears from the scanner/overview and despawns after a few minutes. A new complex of the same size will spawn about 30 minutes after the previous one was captured. On average, there will be one or two complexes of each type in a system. However, if many players have been active in a system recently, it may be the case that, for a brief time, there are no complexes available to capture.
blocks.zh: 据点被占领后，会从扫描器/总览上消失，并在几分钟后消失。前一个据点被占领约 30 分钟后，会刷新一个同样规模的新据点。平均而言，一个星系中每种类型的据点会有一到两个。不过，如果最近有很多玩家在某个星系活动，可能会出现短时间内没有据点可以占领的情况。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Before the Kronos expansion, ships could cloak within the capture radius of complexes. This not only led plex farmers to fit cloaking devices to their ships (allowing them to cloak and escape at the first sign of danger), but also encouraged players to sit in a cloaked Stealth Bomber inside a complex (to ambush incoming ships).
blocks.zh: 在克洛诺斯（Kronos）资料片之前，舰船可以在据点的占领半径内隐形。这不仅导致刷据点的玩家在船上装隐形装置（一有危险迹象就隐形逃跑），还促使玩家开着隐形的隐形轰炸舰蹲在据点里（伏击进来的舰船）。

blocks.en: Complex types
blocks.zh: 据点类型

blocks.en: Complexes come in a variety of types. They vary in:
blocks.zh: 据点有多种类型，区别在于：

en: What kinds of ships are allowed to enter
How long it takes to capture them
How many capsuleers the reward scales to
zh: 奖励按多少名克隆飞行员分摊

blocks.en: The name of a complex contains all information about its type. Names are formed as:
blocks.zh: 据点的名称包含了其类型的全部信息。命名格式为：

blocks.en: [Rank / Size] + [BSC / NVY ADV / ELT] + "- "[Number] OR [Open Complex]
blocks.zh: [等级 / 规模] + [BSC / NVY ADV / ELT] + "- "[数字] 或 [开放据点]

en: BSC - Short for "Basic". Indicates site only allows T1 combat ships to enter. T1 hulls with EWAR and Logistics bonuses cannot enter.
NVY - Short for "Navy". Indicates site only allows T1 and Navy ships to enter, no pirate faction, T2, or T3.
ADV - Short for "Advanced". Indicates site allows T2 and Pirate Faction ships, and T3 ships in some circumstances. SoCT and Triglavian ships are limited to these complexes.
ELT - Short for "Elite". Indicates site allows T1, T2, and T3 ships, with bonuses for T3 ships.
Number - This number indicates the number of characters the site reward scales to before reducing loyalty point payout, either 1 or 5.
Open Complex - This is an open site, a site without restrictions or an acceleration gate, and has a similar defending NPC to large complexes.
Rank/Size - Controls which ship sizes are allowed in, capture times, and the NPC defenders, according to the table.
zh: BSC - “Basic”（基础）的缩写。表示该站点只允许 T1 战斗舰船进入。带有电子战和后勤加成的 T1 船体不能进入。
NVY - “Navy”（海军）的缩写。表示该站点只允许 T1 和海军舰船进入，不允许海盗势力舰船、T2 或 T3。
ADV - “Advanced”（高级）的缩写。表示该站点允许 T2 和海盗势力舰船进入，某些情况下也允许 T3 舰船。圣光（SoCT）和三神裔舰船只能进入这类据点。
ELT - “Elite”（精英）的缩写。表示该站点允许 T1、T2 和 T3 舰船进入，T3 舰船还有加成。
数字 - 这个数字表示站点奖励在开始减少忠诚点发放之前可以分摊的角色数量，为 1 或 5。
开放据点 - 这是开放式站点，没有限制也没有加速门，防守 NPC 与大型据点类似。
等级/规模 - 决定允许进入的舰船尺寸、占领时间和 NPC 防守者，见下表。

en: As of 2022-12-01, there is conflicting text between patch notes, some in-game site beacon descriptions, and in-game descriptions on acceleration gates. The above sizes come from the patch notes should be correct for T1/T2 pirate/navy/empire ships of all sizes. Strategic Cruisers, Tactical Destroyers, and more esoteric classes like Flag Cruisers may have in-game mechanics that conflict with the patch note descriptions of what can slide.
zh: 截至 2022-12-01，更新说明、部分游戏内站点信标描述和游戏内加速门描述之间存在相互矛盾的文字。上面的尺寸来自更新说明，对于各种尺寸的 T1/T2 海盗/海军/帝国舰船应该是正确的。战略巡洋舰、战术驱逐舰以及战地巡洋舰等更特殊的舰船类别，其游戏内机制可能与更新说明中关于能否进门的描述不符。

en: Ventures are no longer able to capture Faction Warfare Complexes.
zh: 冲锋者级已不能再占领势力战争据点。

en: Open complex is without number but it only scale to 5 capsuleers.
zh: 开放据点没有数字，但奖励只按 5 名克隆飞行员分摊。

blocks.en: T3 ships are even more limited in their ability enter complexes, only able to enter ADV plexes of a larger size and Open plexes. (For example, a T3 destroyer can enter an FRF ELT-5, Medium ADV, or Large ADV plex, but it cannot enter a Small ADV plex like other destroyer-sized ships can.) Along this same line, T3 cruisers can only enter Large ADV plexes and Open plexes. T3 destroyers can enter FRF ELT-5 sites, and receive +500 base shield, +500 base armor, and +500 base hull while in the site.
blocks.zh: T3 舰船能进入的据点更加有限，只能进入更大规模的 ADV 据点和开放据点。（例如，T3 驱逐舰可以进入 FRF ELT-5、中型 ADV 或大型 ADV 据点，但不能像其他驱逐舰级别的舰船那样进入小型 ADV 据点。）同理，T3 巡洋舰只能进入大型 ADV 据点和开放据点。T3 驱逐舰可以进入 FRF ELT-5 站点，并在站点内获得 +500 基础护盾、+500 基础装甲和 +500 基础结构。

blocks.en: For example, Amarr Medium NVY-5 would indicate a site in an amarr-owned system where the rewards scale to 5 capsuleers, and Tech 1 or Navy ships of size Cruiser or smaller are allowed inside.
blocks.zh: 例如，Amarr Medium NVY-5 表示该站点位于艾玛控制的星系中，奖励按 5 名克隆飞行员分摊，允许巡洋舰及更小的 T1 或海军舰船进入。

blocks.en: While each type of complex contributes the same amount to capturing a system (measured in victory points), capturing larger complexes result in higher rewards. Additionally, capturing complexes in enemy-held systems (offensive plexing) gives higher rewards than capturing complexes in friendly-held systems (defensive plexing).
blocks.zh: 虽然每种据点对占领星系的贡献（以胜利点数衡量）都相同，但占领更大的据点会获得更高的奖励。此外，在敌方控制的星系中占领据点（进攻刷据点）比在友方控制的星系中占领据点（防守刷据点）奖励更高。

blocks.en: Complexes have two fleets of NPCs, an attacker and a defender. Each side has between 2 and 5 ships, determined by the type of plex; they're designed to be killed without too much trouble by a player ship of similar size. Once killed, the NPC attacker/defender fleet will respawn after, between 90 and 180 seconds for scout and small complexes. In medium and large complexes, the NPC respawns after, between 90 and 300 seconds.
blocks.zh: 据点中有两支 NPC 舰队，一支进攻方，一支防守方。每方有 2 到 5 艘舰船，由据点类型决定；它们的强度设计为同尺寸的玩家舰船不费太多力气就能击杀。被击杀后，侦察和小型据点的 NPC 进攻/防守舰队会在 90 到 180 秒后重新刷新。中型和大型据点的 NPC 则在 90 到 300 秒后重新刷新。

blocks.en: Which systems have complexes and which complexes a system has available can both be found in the Agency window under Encounters -> Faction Warfare.
blocks.zh: 哪些星系有据点、某个星系有哪些据点，都可以在事件中心（Agency）窗口中的“遭遇战 -> 势力战争”下查到。

blocks.en: Battlefields
blocks.zh: 战场

blocks.en: Along with normal Complexes, there are also much larger Factional Warfare sites called Battlefields.
blocks.zh: 除了普通据点之外，还有规模大得多的势力战争站点，称为战场（Battlefield）。

blocks.en: Battlefields have a number of unique capture mechanics:
blocks.zh: 战场有许多独特的占领机制：

en: Battlefields include three separate capture points on grid with each other, with one point in the top middle and the other two approximately 80km on either side.
Holding a capture point earns capture points for your faction when it ticks down. Reaching 100% progress completes the battlefield.
Enemy faction NPCs and enemy militia players within 30km of the capture point pause the capture progress.
Pods cannot capture or hold a point.
Winning a Battlefield provides 150k Loyalty Points to the winning side up to 30 people, with decreasing amounts of Loyalty Points if over 30 people for that side are on grid.
Winning a Battlefield provides a very large amount of Advantage to the winning faction's Advantage system level, as well as 2000 Victory Points.
zh: 战场在同一网格内有三个独立的占领点，一个在上方中间，另外两个分别位于两侧约 80km 处。
守住占领点时，每次倒数结束都会为本方势力赢得占领点数。进度达到 100% 即完成战场。
占领点 30km 内的敌方势力 NPC 和敌方民兵玩家会暂停占领进度。
太空舱无法占领或守住占领点。
赢得战场后，获胜方最多 30 人可获得 150k 忠诚点；如果该方在网格上的人数超过 30 人，每人获得的忠诚点会减少。
赢得战场会为获胜势力所在星系的优势等级提供非常多的优势值，以及 2000 胜利点数。

blocks.en: Battlefields also have unique mechanics for capsuleers sliding in. The inside and outside are both full, normal deadspace. The acceleration gate is further off the beacon than normal FW complexes (10-20km), and only allows T1 and Navy ships.
blocks.zh: 战场对进门的克隆飞行员也有独特的机制。内部和外部都是完整的普通死亡空间。加速门距离信标比普通势力战争据点更远（10-20km），并且只允许 T1 和海军舰船进入。

blocks.en: In contrast to normal Faction Warfare complexes, capture points are typically about 75-125km from the landing point for capsuleers who are not enrolled in Faction Warfare. Those enrolled in Faction Warfare may land closer to capture points. There are three landing points: one for each faction, and one for neutral capsuleers.
blocks.zh: 与普通势力战争据点不同，对于没有参加势力战争的克隆飞行员，占领点通常距离降落点约 75-125km。参加势力战争的人可能会降落在离占领点更近的位置。降落点有三个：每个势力各一个，中立克隆飞行员一个。

blocks.en: Battlefields only spawn in frontline systems. There can be up to two battlefields present at any given time. A new battlefield will spawn three hours after one is completed.
blocks.zh: 战场只会在前线星系刷新。同一时间最多可以有两个战场。一个战场完成三小时后会刷新新的战场。

blocks.en: Infrastructure Hub
blocks.zh: 基础设施枢纽

blocks.en: An infrastructure hub ("I-Hub") in space.
blocks.zh: 太空中的一个基础设施枢纽（“I-Hub”）。

blocks.en: The Infrastructure Hub (or "I-Hub") is a structure in space that the attacking faction needs to destroy in order to capture a system. The I-Hub can be found (and be warped to) from the Overview, but can only be damaged if the star system is in a "vulnerable" state, and then only by pilots of the attacking faction (pilots of the defending faction, pilots in an allied militia, or neutral pilots cannot damage the I-Hub).
blocks.zh: 基础设施枢纽（或“I-Hub”）是太空中的一座建筑，进攻方势力需要摧毁它才能占领星系。I-Hub 可以在总览中找到（并跃迁过去），但只有在星系处于“易攻”状态时才能被攻击，而且只有进攻方势力的驾驶员能对它造成伤害（防守方势力的驾驶员、盟友民兵的驾驶员或中立驾驶员都无法伤害 I-Hub）。

blocks.en: The I-Hub has 25 million hitpoints (HP), with 7.5M HP each in shield and armor, and 10M HP in structure. This means that a medium-sized fleet is needed to destroy an I-Hub in a reasonable period of time (keeping in mind that its peak shield recharge rate is around 1,700 HP/s, which is the absolute minimum amount of DPS needed to break through its shields). Once the I-Hub is destroyed (technically, once it reaches 1% structure), the system will be "lost" and will switch to being occupied by the attacking faction after the next server downtime.
blocks.zh: I-Hub 共有 2500 万点生命值（HP），护盾和装甲各 7.5M HP，结构 10M HP。这意味着需要一支中等规模的舰队才能在合理的时间内摧毁 I-Hub（要记住它的护盾峰值回充速度约为 1,700 HP/s，这是打穿其护盾所需的最低 DPS）。I-Hub 被摧毁后（严格来说，是结构降到 1% 时），星系即“失守”，并会在下一次服务器停机维护后转由进攻方势力占领。

blocks.en: As explained above, if a system is "vulnerable", and if the defending faction can capture enough complexes, the system will revert back to "contested". The I-Hub will then become invulnerable again, and any damage which the attacking faction has so far managed to do to it is reset. Therefore, while attacking the I-Hub, the attacking faction must also prevent the defending faction from capturing complexes.
blocks.zh: 如前所述，如果星系处于“易攻”状态，而防守方势力能够占领足够多的据点，星系就会退回“争夺中”。此时 I-Hub 会再次变为无敌，进攻方势力迄今为止对它造成的所有伤害都会被重置。因此，在攻击 I-Hub 的同时，进攻方势力还必须阻止防守方势力占领据点。

blocks.en: The I-Hub is also the place where pilots of the defending faction can donate loyalty points to upgrade the system.
blocks.zh: I-Hub 也是防守方势力的驾驶员捐献忠诚点升级星系的地方。

blocks.en: Victory points
blocks.zh: 胜利点数

blocks.en: Formally, how "contested" a system is is measured in how many victory points have been accumulated by the attacking faction for that system. If the attacking faction has not yet accumulated any victory points for that system, then the system is "stable". Capturing a complex rewards victory points according to the size and type of complex completed; conversely, if the defending faction captures a complex, victory points are subtracted based on the size and type of complex. In order to bring a system to "vulnerable", the attacking faction must accumulate 75000 victory points. Once a system is vulnerable, the attacking faction can continue capturing complexes until they have a "buffer" of victory points; this is to give themselves some breathing room while they attack the I-Hub .
blocks.zh: 严格来说，星系的“争夺”程度是用进攻方势力在该星系累积的胜利点数来衡量的。如果进攻方势力在该星系尚未累积任何胜利点数，星系就处于“稳定”状态。占领一个据点会根据所完成据点的规模和类型奖励胜利点数；反之，如果防守方势力占领了一个据点，则会根据据点的规模和类型扣除胜利点数。要让星系变为“易攻”，进攻方势力必须累积 75000 胜利点数。星系变为易攻后，进攻方势力可以继续占领据点，直到建立起胜利点数的“缓冲”；这是为了在攻击 I-Hub 时给自己留一些喘息的空间。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Prior to the overhaul to Faction Warfare during the Uprising expansion (2022), capturing a complex (regardless of its size) for the attacking faction rewarded 20 victory points or subtracted 20 victory points for capturing a complex for the defending faction. In order to bring a system to "vulnerable", the attacking faction had to accumulate 3000 victory points (i.e. capture 150 complexes more than the defending faction). Once a system was vulnerable, attackers could continue to earn victory points up to a "buffer" of 100 victory pointsPatch notes: ; the cap on this "buffer" is not documented for post-Uprising Faction Warfare. The Uprising expansion increased the number of victory points needed to accumulate by the attacking faction from 3,000 to 75,000 and changed the number of victory points awarded by completing complexes based on complex size.
blocks.zh: 在起义资料片（2022）对势力战争进行全面改革之前，进攻方势力占领一个据点（无论规模大小）奖励 20 胜利点数，防守方势力占领一个据点则扣除 20 胜利点数。要让星系变为“易攻”，进攻方势力必须累积 3000 胜利点数（即比防守方势力多占领 150 个据点）。星系变为易攻后，进攻方最多可以继续累积 100 胜利点数的“缓冲”。更新说明：；起义之后的势力战争中，这个“缓冲”的上限没有公开说明。起义资料片把进攻方势力需要累积的胜利点数从 3,000 提高到 75,000，并改为根据据点规模决定完成据点所奖励的胜利点数。

blocks.en: Advantage
blocks.zh: 优势

blocks.en: Advantage in a system makes it easier to capture and defend a system. Having the advantage increases the number of victory points gained when capturing complexes in that system; thus the side with the higher advantage can more effectively defend or capture that system. Advantage can be increased by winning Battlefields, successfully deploying Propaganda Broadcast Structures, or completing Rendezvous Point combat sites. It is also possible to reduce the enemy's advantage in a system by destroying enemy supply caches/depots or successfully deploying Listening Outposts.
blocks.zh: 星系中的优势（Advantage）让占领和防守星系变得更容易。拥有优势会增加在该星系占领据点时获得的胜利点数；因此优势更高的一方可以更有效地防守或占领该星系。赢得战场、成功部署广播宣传建筑或完成集合点战斗站点都可以提高优势。摧毁敌方的补给物资库/补给站，或成功部署监听哨站，也可以降低敌方在星系中的优势。

blocks.en: Supply Caches
blocks.zh: 补给物资库

blocks.en: Supply caches, also called supply depots, are NPC faction structures that, when destroyed, will remove 2% advantage in the system from that faction. These structures are guarded by a small NPC fleet of frigates, destroyers, and cruisers. Each faction has their own supply caches that will spawn in frontline and command operation systems in friendly and enemy faction warfare space.
blocks.zh: 补给物资库（Supply Cache），也称为补给站，是 NPC 势力建筑，摧毁后会使该势力在星系中的优势减少 2%。这些建筑由一支由护卫舰、驱逐舰和巡洋舰组成的小型 NPC 舰队守卫。每个势力都有自己的补给物资库，会在友方和敌方势力战争空间的前线和指挥行动星系中刷新。

blocks.en: Supply caches grant 15,000 LP to every player who damaged the structure. There is no limit on the amount of time between damaging the structure and the structure being destroyed for you to qualify to collect the reward. In other words, every pilot who had ever damaged a supply cache would get an LP payout if the supply cache were destroyed. One method of generating LP is to warp to a supply cache, damage it, and warp off before the NPCs can kill you, leaving the job of finishing off the structure to a bigger fleet.
blocks.zh: 补给物资库会给每一个对其造成过伤害的玩家 15,000 LP。从你对建筑造成伤害到建筑被摧毁之间，没有任何时间限制，你都有资格领取奖励。换句话说，只要补给物资库被摧毁，每一个曾经伤害过它的驾驶员都会获得 LP 奖励。一种赚 LP 的方法是跃迁到补给物资库，打它几下，然后在 NPC 杀死你之前跃迁离开，把收尾的工作留给更大的舰队。

blocks.en: For Example: If a Gallente Supply Cache is destroyed every pilot who damaged the Supply Cache will be granted the full LP payout and the Gallente faction will lose some advantage in the system.
blocks.zh: 举例：如果一个盖伦特补给物资库被摧毁，每一个曾伤害过它的驾驶员都会获得全额 LP 奖励，而盖伦特势力会在该星系中失去一些优势。

blocks.en: Rendezvous Points
blocks.zh: 集合点

blocks.en: Rendezvous Points are combat sites found in frontline and occasionally command operations systems, and awards loyalty points and 2% advantage in the system for that faction. The sites must be scanned down and will appear in the probe scanner as level I combat anomalies named for the faction NPCs contained in it, i.e. "Amarr Rendezvous Point". Sites for both empire factions will be present in system with a 15-20 minute respawn timer after a site is completed.
blocks.zh: 集合点（Rendezvous Point）是出现在前线星系、偶尔也出现在指挥行动星系中的战斗站点，会奖励忠诚点，并为该势力在星系中提供 2% 的优势。这些站点需要扫描出来，在探针扫描器中显示为 I 级战斗异常，以其中所含的势力 NPC 命名，例如“Amarr Rendezvous Point”。星系中会同时存在两个帝国势力的站点，站点完成后有 15-20 分钟的刷新时间。

blocks.en: To complete the site, destroy five waves of NPCs. Each of the first four waves contains 3-6 NPCs, although a battleship NPC may spawn instead for the third wave. The fifth wave will spawn an officer battleship NPC; when this NPC is killed, any NPCs remaining will leave the site, and the site is completed.
blocks.zh: 要完成站点，需要消灭五波 NPC。前四波每波有 3-6 个 NPC，不过第三波可能改为刷出一艘战列舰 NPC。第五波会刷出一艘官员战列舰 NPC；击杀它后，剩下的 NPC 都会离开站点，站点即告完成。

blocks.en: A well-fit T1 cruiser or better is recommended, as the battleship NPCs in particular can do over 1000 DPS per volley from over 70km away.
blocks.zh: 建议使用装配精良的 T1 巡洋舰或更好的舰船，因为尤其是战列舰 NPC，每轮齐射可以在 70km 以外打出超过 1000 的 DPS。

blocks.en: Propaganda Broadcast Structures
blocks.zh: 广播宣传建筑

blocks.en: Propaganda Broadcast Structures are deployable objects that when deployed, start a countdown timer for 10 minutes. Waves of NPCs will periodically spawn, pausing the timer, and must be killed to resume the countdown. At the end of the timer, the site is completed and ~1% advantage is awarded in the system for that faction. If the Propaganda Broadcast Structure is destroyed, either by the NPCs or players, before the timer is finished, no advantage is awarded.
blocks.zh: 广播宣传建筑（Propaganda Broadcast Structure）是可部署物品，部署后会开始 10 分钟的倒计时。期间会周期性地刷出成波的 NPC，使计时器暂停，必须击杀它们才能继续倒计时。倒计时结束后，站点完成，该势力在星系中获得约 1% 的优势。如果广播宣传建筑在倒计时结束前被摧毁（无论是被 NPC 还是玩家），则不会获得优势。

blocks.en: The Structure can be obtained by trading 100 LP and an Encoder Splice from the opposing militia's Operation Centers in the LP store. Deploying the item requires the Anchoring skill trained to level 3. Once the item is deployed, it shows up as a warpable beacon on the overview, allowing anyone in system to warp directly to the Structure. Up to three Propaganda Broadcast Structures can be deployed in a system at a time.
blocks.zh: 该建筑可以在 LP 商店中，用 100 LP 加上一个来自敌方民兵行动中心的编码器接片兑换。部署该物品需要把空间定锚技能练到 3 级。物品部署后，会在总览上显示为一个可跃迁的信标，星系中的任何人都可以直接跃迁到该建筑。一个星系中同时最多可以部署三个广播宣传建筑。

blocks.en: A well-fit T1 cruiser or better is recommended.
blocks.zh: 建议使用装配精良的 T1 巡洋舰或更好的舰船。

blocks.en: Listening Posts
blocks.zh: 监听哨站

blocks.en: Similar to Propaganda Broadcast Structures, Listening Posts are are deployable objects that when deployed, start a countdown timer for 10 minutes. Waves of NPCs will periodically spawn, pausing the timer, and must be killed to resume the countdown. At the end of the timer, the site is completed and ~1% advantage is removed in the system from the opposing faction. If the Listening Post is destroyed, either by the NPCs or players, before the timer is finished, advantage is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 与广播宣传建筑类似，监听哨站（Listening Post）也是可部署物品，部署后会开始 10 分钟的倒计时。期间会周期性地刷出成波的 NPC，使计时器暂停，必须击杀它们才能继续倒计时。倒计时结束后，站点完成，敌对势力在星系中的优势会被减少约 1%。如果监听哨站在倒计时结束前被摧毁（无论是被 NPC 还是玩家），优势不会改变。

blocks.en: The Listening Post can be obtained by trading 100 LP and a Decoder Package from the opposing militia's Operation Centers in the LP store. Deploying the item requires the Anchoring skill trained to level 3. Once the item is deployed, it shows up as a warpable beacon on the overview, allowing anyone in system to warp directly to the Structure. Up to three Listening Posts can be deployed in a system at a time.
blocks.zh: 监听哨站可以在 LP 商店中，用 100 LP 加上一个来自敌方民兵行动中心的解码器包裹兑换。部署该物品需要把空间定锚技能练到 3 级。物品部署后，会在总览上显示为一个可跃迁的信标，星系中的任何人都可以直接跃迁到该建筑。一个星系中同时最多可以部署三个监听哨站。

blocks.en: A well-fit T1 cruiser or better is recommended.
blocks.zh: 建议使用装配精良的 T1 巡洋舰或更好的舰船。

blocks.en: Operation Centers
blocks.zh: 行动中心

blocks.en: Operation Centers are level 3 data sites that can only be found in the Rearguard systems of Faction Warfare Lowsec space. The sites can be scanned down by any capsuleer, but only participants in the opposing faction are able to hack the cans.
blocks.zh: 行动中心（Operation Center）是 3 级数据站点，只出现在势力战争低安空间的后方星系中。任何克隆飞行员都可以扫描出这些站点，但只有敌对势力的参战者才能破解其中的容器。

blocks.en: Operation Centers are named for the empire whose system they are in, such as "Caldari Operation Center".
blocks.zh: 行动中心以其所在星系所属的帝国命名，例如“Caldari Operation Center”。

blocks.en: Each site contains 5 cans, one in each direction beside the landing point. The cans are mostly sleeper difficulty and can be failed as many times as necessary without consequences. If a can is successfully hacked, strong NPCs will arrive 5-10 seconds later and attack the hacker. The site will despawn about 20 minutes after a successful hack.
blocks.zh: 每个站点有 5 个容器，分布在降落点周围的各个方向。这些容器大多是冬眠者难度，失败多少次都不会有任何后果。一旦成功破解一个容器，5-10 秒后就会有强力的 NPC 赶到并攻击破解者。成功破解约 20 分钟后，站点会消失。

blocks.en: The most important loot in Operation Centers are the Encoder Splices (e.g. "Caldari Encoder Splice") and Decoder Packages (e.g. "Caldari Decoder Package"), because these sites are the only way to obtain them, and they are required to purchase the Propaganda Broadcast Structure and Listening Outpost, respectively. As such it is recommended to use a cargo scanner to find which can has the Splice and Decoders, and obtain them first.
blocks.zh: 行动中心里最重要的战利品是编码器接片（例如加达里编码器接片）和解码器包裹（例如加达里解码器包裹），因为这些站点是获得它们的唯一途径，而它们分别是兑换广播宣传建筑和监听哨站所必需的。因此建议使用货柜舱扫描设备找出哪个容器里有接片和解码器，优先拿到它们。

blocks.en: Neighboring Systems (Passive Bonus)
blocks.zh: 相邻星系（被动加成）

blocks.en: In addition to various sites that can effect system advantage, frontline systems gain a 10% native advantage bonus for each neighboring faction warfare system controlled by defending or opposing forces. A frontline owned by the Minmatar, for example, with two adjacent Minmatar-held systems and one adjacent Amarr-held system will reward an additional 20% advantage to the Minmatar and 10% advantage to the Amarr, for a net 10% advantage gain to the Minmatar for that frontline system.
blocks.zh: 除了各种能影响星系优势的站点之外，前线星系每有一个相邻的、由防守方或敌对方控制的势力战争星系，就会获得 10% 的原生优势加成。例如，一个由米玛塔尔控制的前线星系，如果有两个相邻的米玛塔尔星系和一个相邻的艾玛星系，米玛塔尔会额外获得 20% 的优势，艾玛获得 10% 的优势，即该前线星系中米玛塔尔净获得 10% 的优势。

blocks.en: System Upgrades and warzone tier
blocks.zh: 星系升级与战区层级

blocks.en: Since Uprising, the rewards scales depending on how close to a system controlled by the opposing faction you are. System are classified as Frontlines (adjacent to an enemy system), where the LP gains are the highest, Commands systems (adjacent to a frontline) and Rearguards systems (adjacent to a Command system or another rearguard).
blocks.zh: 自起义资料片起，奖励会根据你离敌对势力控制的星系有多近而变化。星系分为前线星系（与敌方星系相邻，LP 收益最高）、指挥行动星系（与前线星系相邻）和后方星系（与指挥行动星系或其他后方星系相邻）。

blocks.en: System upgrades
blocks.zh: 星系升级

blocks.en: A system can be upgraded by donating loyalty points (LP) at the system's infrastructure hub. This system is currently at Level 3, nearing Level 4.
blocks.zh: 可以在星系的基础设施枢纽捐献忠诚点（LP）来升级星系。这个星系目前处于 3 级，接近 4 级。

blocks.en: Players participating in Factional Warfare can donate the loyalty points (LP) they earned with their militia corporation to "upgrade" the star systems that their faction currently controls. To do this, they must fly to the system's infrastructure hub, right-click on it, select the "open system upgrade panel" option, and select how much LP they would like to donate. This window also lists the benefits of upgrading a system:
blocks.zh: 参与势力战争的玩家可以把在民兵军团赚到的忠诚点（LP）捐献出来，“升级”本方势力当前控制的星系。具体做法是飞到星系的基础设施枢纽，右键点击它，选择“打开星系升级面板”选项，然后选择要捐献多少 LP。该窗口还列出了升级星系的好处：

en: lower broker fees for contracts and market orders (-10% per system upgrade level)
lower costs for industry activities in NPC stations (-10% per upgrade level)
zh: 降低合同和市场订单的中介费（每个星系升级等级 -10%）
降低在 NPC 空间站进行工业活动的费用（每个升级等级 -10%）

blocks.en: When you donate LP, a part is lost as a "maintenance tax" (for example, if you donate 1,000 LP, and the maintenance tax is 5%, then only 950 LP are actually counted towards upgrading the system). The maintenance tax starts at 0% and increases the higher their faction's tier is, up to about 75%. The LP you donate is put into a pool with the LP donated by other players from your faction in that system, and the size of that pool determines the system's upgrade level. A system can be upgraded up to level 5.
blocks.zh: 捐献 LP 时，会有一部分作为“维护税”损失掉（例如，如果你捐献 1,000 LP，维护税为 5%，那么实际计入星系升级的只有 950 LP）。维护税从 0% 开始，势力层级越高，维护税越高，最高约 75%。你捐献的 LP 会和本势力其他玩家在该星系捐献的 LP 一起放进一个池子，池子的大小决定星系的升级等级。星系最高可以升到 5 级。

blocks.en: The total amount of LP required to upgrade a system is:
blocks.zh: 升级星系所需的 LP 总量为：

blocks.en: The system information display.
blocks.zh: 星系信息显示。

blocks.en: You can check the current upgrade level of a system (along with the associated benefits) through the system information display at the top-left of the screen. Here you can see who currently controls the system, the system state (stable / contested / vulnerable / lost) and its upgrade level.
blocks.zh: 你可以通过屏幕左上角的星系信息显示，查看星系当前的升级等级（以及相应的好处）。在这里你可以看到当前控制该星系的是谁、星系状态（稳定 / 争夺中 / 易攻 / 失守）以及它的升级等级。

blocks.en: The amount of LP in a system's pool is reduced every time a player from the attacking faction captures a complex in that system; 10% of the LP reward they receive is subtracted from the system's LP pool.
blocks.zh: 每当进攻方势力的玩家在该星系占领一个据点，星系 LP 池中的 LP 就会减少；减少的数量为该玩家所获 LP 奖励的 10%。

blocks.en: If the amount of LP in the pool drops below the threshold required for the current system level, then the system's upgrade level will drop accordingly. The defending faction can counteract this by donating more LP to the pool; even if the system is at level 5, they can continue donating LP into a so-called "buffer" (i.e. more LP than is needed to reach level 5) to stop the system dropping to level 4 as soon as one enemy pilot captures a complex.
blocks.zh: 如果池中的 LP 降到当前星系等级所需的门槛以下，星系的升级等级就会相应下降。防守方势力可以通过向池中捐献更多 LP 来抵消这一点；即使星系已经是 5 级，他们也可以继续捐献 LP 作为所谓的“缓冲”（即超出 5 级所需的 LP），以免一个敌方驾驶员占领一个据点就让星系掉到 4 级。

blocks.en: If a system is captured by the attacking faction, then all the upgrades are lost and the system reverts to its base (i.e. "un-upgraded") state.
blocks.zh: 如果星系被进攻方势力占领，所有升级都会丢失，星系恢复到基础（即“未升级”）状态。

blocks.en: With the removal of the pre-Uprising tier system, upgrading faction warfare systems is rarely done outside of local market or industry centers in the warzones.
blocks.zh: 随着起义之前的层级系统被移除，除了战区中的本地市场或工业中心之外，现在已经很少有人升级势力战争星系了。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Faction tier The more systems in a war zone a faction controls and the more those systems are upgraded, the higher the rewards the pilots who fight for that faction receive. This is represented by the "faction tier" mechanic: each faction receives a point for each system they control in their war zone, plus an additional point for every system level upgrade (so an un-upgraded system is worth 1 point, a system upgraded to level 1 is worth 2 points, a system upgraded to level 2 is worth 3 points, a system upgraded to level 3 is worth 4 points, and so forth).The number of points a faction has is then compared to the total number of available points in a war zone (which is equal to the number of systems in the war zone multiplied by 6 (as a system can be upgraded up to level 5, and a level 5 system is worth 6 points)). Hence, the number of points a faction has determines its tier: The main effect of faction tier is that it affects how many loyalty points you receive for various activities you do in Factional Warfare; the higher your faction's tier, the higher your rewards. For example, the base reward for capturing a scout complex in an enemy-held system is 10,000 LP. If your faction is at Tier 1, then you will only receive 5,000 LP, while if your faction was at Tier 4, you would receive 25,000 LP for capturing that same complex! This bonus affects capturing complexes and running missions, but not ship kills.If you open the militia window in a station then you can see the tier of that faction's war zone (so the militia office at a Minmatar station would show the tiers in the Amarr-Minmatar war zone), as well as the number of systems (and their upgrade levels) currently controlled by that faction. Dotlan also shows the system occupancy and the system state (stable/contested/vulnerable), but not the system upgrade level or the faction tier.
blocks.zh: 势力层级 一个势力在战区中控制的星系越多、这些星系升级得越高，为该势力作战的驾驶员获得的奖励就越高。这通过“势力层级”机制来体现：每个势力在其战区中每控制一个星系得 1 分，每个星系每升一级再额外得 1 分（所以未升级的星系值 1 分，升到 1 级的星系值 2 分，升到 2 级的星系值 3 分，升到 3 级的星系值 4 分，依此类推）。然后把势力的得分与战区中可获得的总分进行比较（总分等于战区中星系数量乘以 6（因为星系最高可升到 5 级，而 5 级星系值 6 分））。因此，势力的得分决定了它的层级：势力层级的主要作用是影响你在势力战争中进行各种活动所获得的忠诚点数量；你所在势力的层级越高，奖励就越高。例如，在敌方控制的星系中占领一个侦察据点的基础奖励为 10,000 LP。如果你的势力处于第 1 层级，你只能获得 5,000 LP；而如果你的势力处于第 4 层级，占领同一个据点你能获得 25,000 LP！这项加成影响占领据点和执行任务，但不影响击杀舰船。如果你在空间站中打开民兵窗口，就可以看到该势力所在战区的层级（所以在米玛塔尔空间站的民兵办公室会显示艾玛-米玛塔尔战区的层级），以及该势力当前控制的星系数量（及其升级等级）。Dotlan 也会显示星系归属和星系状态（稳定/争夺中/易攻），但不显示星系升级等级或势力层级。

blocks.en: Factional Warfare missions
blocks.zh: 势力战争任务

blocks.en: Main article: Factional Warfare missions
blocks.zh: 主条目：势力战争任务

blocks.en: Each of the four Factional Warfare NPC corporations ("militias") have a number of agents which offer missions to pilots enlisted with their militia (and their allied militia). These missions are similar to the encounter missions offered by agents of Empire corporations, but they are run exclusively in the war zones (although they do not contribute to capturing or defending star systems in those war zones). You are rewarded with ISK and loyalty points (LP) for completing these missions.
blocks.zh: 四个势力战争 NPC 军团（“民兵”）各有若干代理人，向参加本民兵（及其盟友民兵）的驾驶员提供任务。这些任务与帝国军团代理人提供的战斗任务类似，但只在战区内执行（不过它们对占领或防守战区星系没有贡献）。完成这些任务可以获得 ISK 和忠诚点（LP）奖励。

blocks.en: Rewards
blocks.zh: 奖励

blocks.en: While the primary reason for Factional Warfare is to encourage PvP in low-sec, players are also rewarded directly for participating in the Factional Warfare mechanics.
blocks.zh: 虽然势力战争的主要目的是鼓励低安中的 PvP，但玩家参与势力战争机制也能直接获得奖励。

blocks.en: Complexes and I-Hubs
blocks.zh: 据点与 I-Hub

blocks.en: When you capture a complex you are rewarded with loyalty points (for your faction's militia corporation, so a pilot flying for the Gallente would receive LP for the Federal Defense Union). The LP rewards for capturing a complex in an enemy-held system ("offensive plexing") depend on the size of the complex and on the system's status (Frontline, Command Operation or Rearguard). A Rearguard system has a -99% LP multiplier, while other status are shown in a table below. You have to be within the complex' capture radius at the moment it's completed (i.e. when the timer runs out) to receive a reward; if there are multiple pilots within the complex at the moment it's completed, the LP reward is split evenly between them (irrespective of how long they have been there). You get no rewards for partially completing a complex!
blocks.zh: 占领一个据点后，你会获得忠诚点奖励（属于你所在势力的民兵军团，所以为盖伦特作战的驾驶员会获得联邦防务联合会的 LP）。在敌方控制的星系中占领据点（“进攻刷据点”）的 LP 奖励取决于据点的规模和星系的状态（前线、指挥行动或后方）。后方星系的 LP 倍率为 -99%，其他状态见下表。据点完成的那一刻（即计时器归零时），你必须在据点的占领半径内才能获得奖励；如果据点完成时有多名驾驶员在据点内，LP 奖励会在他们之间平分（不管他们待了多久）。只完成部分据点是没有任何奖励的！

blocks.en: The LP rewards for capturing a complex in a friendly-held system. This example is based on a scout complex at tier 2 (base reward: 10,000 LP).
blocks.zh: 在友方控制的星系中占领据点的 LP 奖励。本例基于第 2 层级的侦察据点（基础奖励：10,000 LP）。

blocks.en: When capturing a complex in a friendly-held system ("defensive plexing"), you receive the full reward so long as the system is either vulnerable or contested. If the system is stable, you receive nothing.
blocks.zh: 在友方控制的星系中占领据点（“防守刷据点”）时，只要星系处于易攻或争夺中状态，你就能获得全额奖励。如果星系处于稳定状态，你什么也得不到。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Before the Catalyst expansion: If you captured a complex in a friendly-held system ("defensive plexing"), you received a reduced reward based on how contested the system is. The formula for this was:LP reward = Base reward of complex × (Contested percentage of the system/100) × 0.75This means capturing a complex in a friendly-held system paid out, at most, 75% as much as capturing an equivalent complex in an enemy-held system, and the closer the system is to "stable", the lower the reward.
blocks.zh: 在催化剂（Catalyst）资料片之前：如果你在友方控制的星系中占领据点（“防守刷据点”），会根据星系的争夺程度获得减少后的奖励。公式为：LP 奖励 = 据点基础奖励 × (星系争夺百分比/100) × 0.75。这意味着在友方控制的星系中占领据点，最多只能获得在敌方星系中占领同等据点奖励的 75%，而且星系越接近“稳定”，奖励就越低。

blocks.en: The base reward for destroying an infrastructure hub ("I-Hub") is 40,000 LP, split between all the pilots who damaged the I-Hub.
blocks.zh: 摧毁基础设施枢纽（“I-Hub”）的基础奖励为 40,000 LP，由所有对 I-Hub 造成过伤害的驾驶员平分。

blocks.en: Missions
blocks.zh: 任务

blocks.en: Missions in Factional Warfare, just like missions anywhere else in EVE, pay in both ISK and loyalty points (LP). The rewards from these missions depend on both the mission level (i.e. their difficulty) and the security rating of the system where the agent is located (the lower the security rating, the higher the rewards). Any levels of the Negotiation and Security Connections skills you have trained increase the ISK and LP rewards, respectively. In addition (just like with capturing complexes), the LP rewards are also affected by your faction's tier (so if a mission normally pays, say 1000 LP, but your faction is at tier 3, you would receive 1000 + 75% = 1750 LP). Since these different bonuses stack, the LP rewards from high-level missions (when combined with a high faction tier and a few levels of the Security Connections skill) can be very high indeed.
blocks.zh: 势力战争中的任务和 EVE 其他地方的任务一样，同时奖励 ISK 和忠诚点（LP）。这些任务的奖励取决于任务等级（即难度）和代理人所在星系的安全等级（安全等级越低，奖励越高）。你练过的谈判技巧和安全关系学技能等级，分别会提高 ISK 和 LP 奖励。此外（和占领据点一样），LP 奖励还受你所在势力层级的影响（所以如果一个任务通常给 1000 LP，而你的势力处于第 3 层级，你会获得 1000 + 75% = 1750 LP）。由于这些不同的加成可以叠加，高等级任务的 LP 奖励（再加上较高的势力层级和几级安全关系学技能）确实可以非常高。

blocks.en: Note that, unlike missions in Empire space, the NPC enemies you kill in Factional Warfare missions do not have bounties on them and drop very little loot (other than Navy tags, which can be sold or used to buy items in the LP store).
blocks.zh: 注意，与帝国空间的任务不同，势力战争任务中你击杀的 NPC 敌人没有赏金，掉落的战利品也非常少（除了海军标签，它可以出售，也可以用来在 LP 商店兑换物品）。

blocks.en: Destroying enemy player's ships
blocks.zh: 击毁敌方玩家的舰船

blocks.en: In addition to any loot you may recover from the wreck of any enemy player's ships you destroy, you will also receive loyalty points based on the value of the ship you killed (including modules and the contents of their cargo bay):
blocks.zh: 除了可以从你击毁的敌方玩家舰船残骸中回收战利品之外，你还会根据所击毁舰船的价值（包括装备和货柜舱内的物品）获得忠诚点：

blocks.en: LP reward=3.25×(value of ship hull−value of ship insurance+value of modules/rigs/subsystem/cargo ) / 10,000
blocks.zh: LP 奖励=3.25×(舰船船体价值−舰船保险价值+装备/改装件/子系统/货物价值) / 10,000

blocks.en: As with capturing complexes, if several pilots are involved in killing a ship, the reward is shared equally between them. The LP reward scales with faction tier, but is capped at 50,000 LP per kill.
blocks.zh: 和占领据点一样，如果有多名驾驶员参与击杀一艘舰船，奖励会在他们之间平分。LP 奖励随势力层级变化，但每次击杀最多 50,000 LP。

blocks.en: Factional Warfare LP store
blocks.zh: 势力战争 LP 商店

blocks.en: As with all corporations which reward loyalty points (LP), the four faction militia corporations each have a LP store where you can buy implants, modules, ships, blueprints and skillbooks with the LP you have earned. These stores stock a similar range of items to their respective faction navies' LP stores, but at a discount (for example, the Apocalypse Navy Issue costs 600,000 LP from the Amarr Navy LP store, but only 250,000 LP from the 24th Imperial Crusade LP store).
blocks.zh: 和所有奖励忠诚点（LP）的军团一样，四个势力民兵军团各有一个 LP 商店，你可以用赚到的 LP 在那里购买植入体、装备、舰船、蓝图和技能书。这些商店出售的物品种类与各自势力海军的 LP 商店相似，但价格更优惠（例如，灾难级海军型在艾玛海军 LP 商店要 600,000 LP，而在帝国十字军第二十四军团 LP 商店只要 250,000 LP）。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Before the Inferno expansion, the faction tier directly reduced prices in each militia's LP store (so an item would be cheaper the higher the faction tier). This led to a massive see-saw as the factions earned their LP at lower tiers, then made a massive push to tier 5, cashed out all their LP into items (promptly crashing the markets for those items), before letting their tier drop again.
blocks.zh: 在地狱（Inferno）资料片之前，势力层级会直接降低各民兵 LP 商店的价格（势力层级越高，物品越便宜）。这导致了剧烈的跷跷板效应：各势力在低层级时积攒 LP，然后集中力量冲到第 5 层级，把所有 LP 兑换成物品（随即让这些物品的市场崩盘），之后再任由层级回落。

blocks.en: Standings and ranks
blocks.zh: 声望与军衔

blocks.en: Main article: Factional Warfare Standings
blocks.zh: 主条目：势力战争声望

blocks.en: Participating in Factional Warfare can impact your standings towards, notably, the militia corporations and the empire factions. High standings towards your faction militia corporation not only grants you access to higher-level mission agents, but also awards you "ranks" (which are visible on the "decorations" tab in your character sheet). You are promoted to a higher rank every time your standings reach an integer number (i.e. 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 - unmodified); when you are promoted, you also receive a one-off bonus to your standings with your faction. Otherwise, your rank is purely cosmetic. Faction police of the enemy faction will attack you in hisec space of the opposing empire faction while you are enrolled in factional warfare.
blocks.zh: 参与势力战争会影响你的声望，特别是对民兵军团和帝国势力的声望。对本势力民兵军团的高声望不仅能让你接触到更高等级的任务代理人，还会授予你“军衔”（可以在角色表的“勋章”标签页中看到）。每当你的声望达到一个整数（即 1.0、2.0、3.0——未修正值），你就会晋升到更高的军衔；晋升时，你还会获得一次性的本势力声望加成。除此之外，军衔纯粹是装饰性的。在你参加势力战争期间，敌对帝国势力的势力警察会在其高安空间中攻击你。

blocks.en: Factional Campaigns
blocks.zh: 势力战役

blocks.en: Beginning with the Faction Warfare "Allegiance" Patch (Version 21.03, March 14, 2023), a series of Factional Campaigns have occurred, allowing pilots to support one of the four Empires in a series of events, leading to rewards for participation in furthering that Empire's goals in the campaign.
blocks.zh: 从势力战争“效忠”（Allegiance）更新（版本 21.03，2023 年 3 月 14 日）开始，陆续举行了一系列势力战役，驾驶员可以在一系列活动中支持四大帝国之一，并因为协助推进该帝国在战役中的目标而获得奖励。

blocks.en: The following Campaigns have occurred:
blocks.zh: 已举行的战役如下：

blocks.en: Shipcaster Shadow War - March 14, 2023 - June 20, 2023.
blocks.zh: 舰船投送器暗影战争（Shipcaster Shadow War） - 2023 年 3 月 14 日 - 2023 年 6 月 20 日。

blocks.en: Permanent war
blocks.zh: 永久战争

blocks.en: Being enlisted in a Factional Warfare militia (be it as a solo player or as a corporation) means that you are constantly at war with:
blocks.zh: 加入势力战争民兵（无论是以个人还是以军团身份）意味着你始终处于与以下对象的战争状态：

en: the players enlisted in the enemy militia, and
zh: 加入敌方民兵的玩家，以及
敌方 NPC 海军势力。

blocks.en: The first of these is similar to being a member of a player-run corporation which is at war with another player-run corporation. You can attack pilots who are enlisted in the enemy militia anywhere in New Eden (CONCORD or sentry guns will not interfere) without impacting your security status (and, of course, they can also attack you!). This effect is most felt in high-sec, where you now have to be on the lookout for enemy players.
blocks.zh: 第一点类似于身为一个与另一个玩家军团处于战争状态的玩家军团的成员。你可以在新伊甸的任何地方攻击加入敌方民兵的驾驶员（统合部和岗哨炮不会干涉），而且不会影响你的安全等级（当然，他们也可以攻击你！）。这一点在高安中感受最明显，你现在必须时刻提防敌方玩家。

blocks.en: The second of these restrict your movement through high-sec systems controlled by the enemy faction. When you enter one of these systems, you will get a text warning on your screen; if you don't leave the system promptly, you will be attacked by NPC faction navy ships. These ships are more powerful the higher the security rating of the system you are in, and will use electronic warfare against you (such as neuts/nos and webs). They will not point you, but they will web you, meaning if you warp off immediately it requires a very slow ship to be caught. They also do not scram, so if you are caught, you can still MJD to escape. Unlike CONCORD, it's certainly feasible to survive encounters with them and with specifics fitting to sustain the NPC DPS it's even possible to "camp" in enemy space to catch opposing militia players - but they make travel through enemy-held high-sec a hassle at the least). The in-game star map (or a third-party site like Dotlan) can help you to plan safe routes.
blocks.zh: 第二点限制了你在敌方势力控制的高安星系中的行动。当你进入这类星系时，屏幕上会出现文字警告；如果你不迅速离开，就会遭到 NPC 势力海军舰船的攻击。你所在星系的安全等级越高，这些舰船就越强，它们还会对你使用电子战（例如掏电/吸电和停滞网）。它们不会对你上跃迁扰断，但会给你上停滞网，所以只要你立刻跃迁离开，只有非常慢的船才会被抓住。它们也不会上跃迁扰乱，所以即使被抓住，你仍然可以用微型跳跃引擎（MJD）逃脱。与统合部不同，在遭遇它们时存活下来是完全可行的，如果针对性地装配以承受 NPC 的 DPS，甚至可以在敌方空间“蹲守”以抓捕敌方民兵玩家——但至少，它们会让你穿越敌方控制的高安变得很麻烦。游戏内的星图（或 Dotlan 这样的第三方网站）可以帮你规划安全的路线。

blocks.en: Additionally, you cannot dock or undock with a ship at both NPC stations and player-owned structures in the enemy-controlled Command Ops or Rearguard systems (but you can dock at enemy NPC stations in all other parts of space). You can only dock or undock in a capsule. This means that if you have items or ships in such a location, you cannot access them until your faction makes it a Frontline system (you can create a contract with a neutral player, alt, or hauling service to get your items out, or temporarily leave the militia to regain access to your assets).
blocks.zh: 此外，在敌方控制的指挥行动或后方星系中，你无法驾驶舰船在 NPC 空间站和玩家建筑停靠或离站（但在其他所有空间区域，你都可以在敌方 NPC 空间站停靠）。你只能乘坐太空舱停靠或离站。这意味着，如果你在这类地方有物品或舰船，在本方势力把该星系变成前线星系之前，你都无法取用它们（你可以与中立玩家、小号或运输服务创建合同把物品运出来，或者暂时退出民兵以重新获得资产的使用权）。

blocks.en: Leaving Factional Warfare
blocks.zh: 退出势力战争

blocks.en: You can leave Factional Warfare at any time through the Militia window if you joined as a solo player (or, for an entire corporation, the CEO or Director can do this). You will keep any loyalty points you have earned, but will no longer be able to participate in the formal Factional Warfare mechanics (capturing complexes and systems, or running missions). Additionally, you can re-enlist at any time (provided you meet the criteria).
blocks.zh: 如果你是以个人身份加入的，可以随时通过民兵窗口退出势力战争（如果是整个军团，则由 CEO 或总监操作）。你会保留已经赚到的所有忠诚点，但将无法再参与正式的势力战争机制（占领据点和星系，或执行任务）。此外，你可以随时重新参军（只要满足条件）。

blocks.en: If at any point your (unmodified, i.e. without taking skills into account) standings towards your faction drop below 0.0, you will receive a warning mail to raise them back up at the next server downtime. If you have not recovered your standings until the downtime after that (i.e. two downtimes after the standing drop), you will be instantly kicked out of the FW militia. The same rules apply for a corporation that join FW, except that in that case, it's the corporation's faction standings that counts.
blocks.zh: 如果在任何时候，你对本势力的声望（未修正值，即不考虑技能）降到 0.0 以下，你会收到一封警告邮件，要求你在下一次服务器停机维护前把声望提上来。如果到再下一次停机维护时（即声望下降后的第二次停机维护）你仍未恢复声望，就会被立即踢出势力战争民兵。加入势力战争的军团也适用同样的规则，只不过在这种情况下计算的是军团的势力声望。

blocks.en: After you leave Factional Warfare the navies of your enemy factions will still attack you for several hours (even if you join the opposing faction militia!) Your status as an "enemy of the state" does not show up in your standings, so be careful when you attempt to travel. Either re-logging into your character or waiting up to 16 hours is enough for the enemy navies to forget about you, though this mechanic remains unexplored as to whether it is functioning as intended or in any form of consistency.
blocks.zh: 退出势力战争后，敌对势力的海军仍会在几个小时内继续攻击你（即使你加入了敌对势力的民兵也是如此！）。你作为“国家公敌”的状态不会显示在声望中，所以出行时要小心。重新登录角色，或者最多等待 16 小时，敌方海军就会忘掉你，不过这个机制是否按设计运作、是否具有一致性，目前仍未被弄清楚。

blocks.en: Frontlines report
blocks.zh: 前线报告

blocks.en: The Frontlines report page provides live updates on the state of Factional Warfare in New Eden. The page features maps of conflict hotspots, information on the warzones, and a new video outlining how Factional Warfare works. The API for this tool is available at https://www.eveonline.com/api/warzone
blocks.zh: 前线（Frontlines）报告页面提供新伊甸势力战争状态的实时更新。该页面包括冲突热点地图、战区信息，以及一段介绍势力战争玩法的新视频。该工具的 API 地址为 https://www.eveonline.com/api/warzone

blocks.en: Third-party sites such as Capsuleers.app also show whether each war zone system is currently a Frontline, Command Operations or Rearguard system, on a war zone map and in a filterable list.
blocks.zh: Capsuleers.app 等第三方网站也会在战区地图和可筛选的列表中，显示每个战区星系当前是前线、指挥行动还是后方星系。
